messages:
Zara (People Ops): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A. Threading the leftover leveling/promo/comp/benefits questions we didn't get to. I'll answer what I can and ping Finance/payroll for the rest. Drop follow-ups here. :wave:

Tom (Backend Eng): Two quick ones: 1) if my promotion is approved and the approval hits right before payroll cutoff, will the raise be in that pay run? 2) can retro pay be applied back to the review period?

Zara (People Ops): Short answers: 1) if People Ops finalizes before payroll cutoff we include it in that run; otherwise it goes to the next payroll. 2) Retro to the review period is possible but requires manager request within 30 days of the People Ops approval timestamp + Finance sign-off. Anything >30 days needs Exec approval.

Hana (EM): Clarify what counts as "approval timestamp"  is it manager submit or People Ops finalize? We get asked this a lot.

Zara (People Ops): It's the People Ops finalization timestamp in Workday (when we mark the promotion approved). That's the canonical time for payroll, retro windows, and appeals deadlines.

Priyanka (Finance): Adding: if a retro is approved after payroll has closed, expect the adjustment on the next available payroll; manual entries can take up to 2 pay cycles. Also: year-end bonus treatment depends on declaration date (promos before declaration = new level; after = prorated by days-at-level).

Tom (Backend Eng): International edge-case: I'm on the UK payroll. If my USD-equivalent band changes with a promotion, how do we handle currency conversion and offer metadata?

Priyanka (Finance): Good call. For cross-border converts we use the exchange rate on the approval date for internal band mapping, but local payroll determines actual salary in local currency. Recruiting should include local-currency bands in offers for international candidates. If you want the exact conversion we can pull the rate for you  ping me.

Hana (EM): Appeals process timeline? If an IC thinks calibration missed context, what's the window and expected turnaround?

Zara (People Ops): Appeals: submit a brief appeal to people-ops@redwood.com with manager support within 5 business days of the calibration lock date. People Ops + manager + calibration chair do a focused review within ~7 business days. Outcomes = no-change / level update / manager action plan. We don't re-run full cycles for single appeals.

Tom (Backend Eng): Equity question: does promotion change next vesting tranche / refresh eligibility? Heard conflicting stuff.

Zara (People Ops): Promotion doesn't change scheduled vesting dates. Refresh eligibility = typically ~6 months after promo for ICs; manager + People Ops + Finance must sign off on exceptions. If you'd like a one-off review, DM me with role + promo date.

Ava (CEO): Leadership ask: please publish a 1-page "Promo & Pay FAQ" (bullets: timeline, payroll effects, retro window, appeals steps, manager checklist). Keep it short and actionable; pin it here.

Zara (People Ops): Will do. I'll draft the one-pager + a 3-item manager checklist (docs to upload, calibration notes, appeal instructions) and post by Friday. I'll pin the doc and update this thread when live.

Payroll-Bot: Reminder: comp packets & calibration materials due to #people-ops by 4/18 17:00 UTC. Upload via: https://intranet.redwood.com/hr/comp-planning

Tom (Backend Eng): Thanks 94 this helps a lot.

Zara (People Ops): Thanks all  if you have a private case DM me and include "private appeal" in the subject. Keeping this thread pinned for the week. :pushpin:
